transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety and insurance issue. I received the signed fire-marshal certificate after the morning operations meeting, and it caps Hall B at exactly 140 audience members because one exit is currently under repair. Additionally, our insurer requires a filed crowd-flow plan specifying one-way entry before admission is allowed. I have not yet attached this certificate to the venue file, so it hasn't been reflected in the draft run sheet. If we're moving to Hall B as Leila's KDM issue seems to require, we cannot keep the 180 audience member count — we'd need to reduce to 140 — and we'd need to implement one-way entry rather than the standard two-way audience movement currently in the plan.
